-- Bell, Book and Candle
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Bell Book and Candle, realistic interior, Okoboji Summer Theatre, mid-century, 1950s'
WHERE slug = 'bell-book-and-candle';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'bell-book-and-candle'
AND t.name IN ('Mid-Century Modern', 'Realistic Interior', '1950s', 'Summer Stock', '2025', 'Comedy');
